# crumbkit's schemas

These files are copies of `crates/crumbkit/schemas/commands-list-v1.json`,
`schemas-list-v1.json`, `schemas-show-v1.json` and `failure-v1.json` from
crumbkit at commit `45d0015e1f94f6bcf26887f943aa14bce8fdb510`, the 0.2.0
release and the commit that `scripts/install-test-tools.sh` installs shelf
and reading from. They move with that commit.
